title: 霜晶织术

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：正面冰晶台、左上窗光、四工具与黑猫可辨，实心冰台延伸到底边。仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot master for The Magician, theme 霜晶织术 / Frost Crystal Weaving. Use the supplied original as visual identity reference: one dark-haired magician in deep indigo robe with ivory sleeves, one discernible black cat, raised hand pointing to sky and lowered hand toward the work. FOUR separate clear magic implements are on a broad frontal ice worktable: wand, chalice, sword and pentacle disc, each visibly distinct and not hidden by hands. Invent a bright ice-crystal workshop with transparent faceted prisms refracting light from an upper-left window diagonally to the table, cobalt blue and pale violet shadows, cold white sparkle; keep natural human skin. Low frontal view; magician behind table, black cat safely at one side. The table must have a substantial solid ice base extending fully to the bottom edge, no floating thin slab. Painterly high-end tarot illustration with fine celestial gold border, controlled highlights, readable hands and tools. Exactly one person, one cat, four tools. No writing, typography, title, numbers, watermark or logo. Opaque complete master for later layer extraction.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、双手、桌面四工具及黑猫整体；禁止分别漂移工具与手；本主题支撑归属：冰台实心底座连到下缘. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture.
